Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 94 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya orders the soldiers of Pipliwan to retreat, but Chandragupta announces that he will put an end to Dhananand's life. He falls down unconsciously because of the affect of the poison of 'Naagpushpa'. Indrajalik and Sthoolbhadra create the smoke and manage to escape him from the palace. The Magadha army tries to chase down the soldiers of Pipliwan in order to catch Chanakya and Chandragupta. Agnimukh along with few soldiers fights against the Magadha army in order to give time for the escape of Chandragupta and Chanakya.
